integrity: The primary source was inspected at its two-point packet lemma, one-way preservation theorem, bidirectional criterion, and the a=2 hyperbolic radial example. The proof independently verifies the metric stretch for arbitrary a and constructs the contracting counterexample packet by packet. The classical quasiconformal preserver theorem was inspected in primary full text and does not cover the nontrivial radial dilations, which are non-quasiconformal.
scientific_limitations: The classification is specific to the canonical hyperbolic radial-dilation semigroup D_a(R,theta)=(aR,theta). It does not classify arbitrary radial disk homeomorphisms. For contracting parameters the proof gives an explicit packet obstruction, not a classification of all sequences whose interpolation property fails.
title: Sharp one-way threshold for hyperbolic radial dilations of Carleson interpolation
